id.description: Identifier of the project, read by `${project.id}`. Letters, digits, `_` and `-`.

name.description: Display name of the project, read by `${project.name}`.

values.description: Values that documents read with `${values.…}`. Entries may use references, but not `${values.…}`.

environments.description: Environments that can be selected when loading. Each one's `values` are merged over the top-level `values`.

values.description: Values that replace or add to the top-level `values`.

imports.description: Glob patterns of the documents to load, relative to this file. `*` stays in one folder; `**` crosses folders.
